gate: Harmange 2023 author-processed exp1 lineage carrier qualification
permitted_operations: download and SHA-256 hash the exact public author RDS
read only row names and the metadata columns lin, startID, well and rep
record source object class/version fields and metadata column names without reading assay matrices
compute lineage counts, lineage-size distribution, startID distribution and well/rep coverage
write an aggregate lineage-carrier table containing lineage, startID and cell count only
forbidden_operations: read clusterID, crID, dir_crID, states or any other biological outcome field
select lineages based on final transcriptional state
